chunks: Al-Ḥalabī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who scratches himself while he is in salat (prayer).

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abā ʿAbdillāh, Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: a man; the person being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.الْحَلَبِيُّ: Al-Ḥalabī, the narrator who asked the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to scratch oneself during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning minor bodily movement during salat (prayer). It indicates that scratching oneself in prayer does not invalidate it and is not problematic.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1069 - Al-Halabi asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about a person who scratches himself while in prayer.
